name: Shouryuu Senki Tenmu
source:
Naomichi met Tenmu the other day. When he was on his way home, a man suddenly appeared in front of him and said, "My name is Kenshin. I'll need to erase you because you saw my face...." Just when he attacked Naomichi, he heard something and Tenmu came down. "You might be the one who gives me power. Please take my hand." He didn't know what to do, but he grabbed her hand. "Armor change!!" When she said so, Naomichi transformed into her armor. It seems Tenmu is a battle princess who fights against Kenshin....

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20090107145431/http://www.erogeshop.com:80/product_info.php/products_id/1010622]Eroge Shop[/url]]
translation:
直道前几天遇见了天梦。一天回家途中，一名男子突然出现在他面前，说道："我叫谦信。既然你看见了我的脸，我就必须把你抹除…"就在他袭击直道时，某种声音响起，天梦从天而降。"你或许就是能赐予我力量的人。请握住我的手。"直道不知该怎么办，却还是抓住了她的手。"铠甲变换！！"话音落下，直道竟化作了她的铠甲。看来，天梦是一位与谦信战斗的战姬…
